description: Daily Sales Plan — AI-powered guided action queue that scans the pipeline, generates prioritized sales actions with pre-generated content, and auto-logs completed actions as notes

userStories.title: Autopilot types and interfaces
userStories.description: As a developer, I need TypeScript types for the autopilot queue system so all components share a consistent data contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Add AutopilotAction interface to types.ts with fields: id (string), leadId (string), leadName (string), contactName (string optional), email (string optional), phone (string optional), actionType ('email' | 'call' | 'social' | 'note'), priority (number 1-10), reasoning (string), content (string optional — filled lazily), status ('pending' | 'completed' | 'skipped')
Add AutopilotQueue interface to types.ts: generatedAt (ISO string), actions (AutopilotAction[])
Add optional autopilotStatuses field (string[]) to the existing AppSettings interface in types.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Autopilot settings — configurable statuses
userStories.description: As a user, I want to choose which pipeline statuses are included in the Daily Sales Plan so that I only see actions for leads I'm actively working.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an Autopilot section to the Settings page (components/SettingsPage.tsx) within the General settings area, showing checkboxes for each configured pipeline status
Selected statuses are saved via the existing updateSettings flow using the new autopilotStatuses field on AppSettings
Default: all statuses except the last one (typically DEAD) are selected when autopilotStatuses is undefined/null
Update fetchSettings in services/crmService.ts to read autopilot_statuses from the settings row and map to autopilotStatuses on AppSettings
Update saveSettings in services/crmService.ts to write autopilot_statuses to the settings row from settings.autopilotStatuses
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser

userStories.title: Client-side lead pre-filtering utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a utility function that filters and ranks leads for autopilot queue generation, so only the most relevant leads are sent to the AI.
acceptanceCriteria: Create utils/autopilotHelpers.ts with a preFilterLeads(leads: Lead[], settings: AppSettings) function
Filters out leads whose status is not in settings.autopilotStatuses (default to all statuses except the last if autopilotStatuses is undefined)
Filters out leads that have a note with today's date (new Date(note.createdAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString())
Ranks remaining leads by: days since last contact descending, matchScore descending (default 0), noteCount ascending
Returns top 60 leads as compact summaries: { id, companyName, status, matchScore, daysSinceLastContact, noteCount, description } where description is truncated to 100 chars
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Queue generation via AI (Pass 1 — stubs)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the system to analyze my pipeline and generate a prioritized list of action stubs so I know exactly what to do next.
acceptanceCriteria: Add generate_queue case to the switch in supabase/functions/ai-gateway/index.ts that accepts payload.leadSummaries and payload.companyContext, sends a prompt to Gemini requesting prioritized action stubs, and returns JSON array of stubs

AI prompt instructs: return max 20 actions, max 2 per lead, each stub has leadId, leadName, actionType (email|call|social|note), priority (1-10), reasoning (1 sentence). Use responseMimeType: 'application/json'

Add generateActionQueue(leadSummaries, settings, products) function in services/geminiService.ts that calls callGateway('generate_queue', ...) and returns AutopilotAction[] with id generated via Math.random().toString(36), content set to undefined, status set to 'pending'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Action content generation via AI (Pass 2 — on-demand)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the system to generate the full content for an action when I'm ready to work on it, so content is fresh and context-specific.
acceptanceCriteria: Add generate_action_content case to the switch in supabase/functions/ai-gateway/index.ts that accepts payload.prompt and returns generated content as JSON, using responseMimeType: 'application/json'

Add generateActionContent(lead, actionType, settings, products) function in services/geminiService.ts that builds an appropriate prompt based on actionType and calls callGateway('generate_action_content', ...)

For email actionType: returns { subject: string, body: string }. For call: returns { script: string }. For social: returns { content: string, rationale: string }. For note: returns { content: string }
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: useAutopilotQueue hook — queue state management
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a custom hook that manages the autopilot queue lifecycle (load, generate, complete, snooze, persist) independently from CRMContext.
acceptanceCriteria: Create hooks/useAutopilotQueue.ts exporting useAutopilotQueue() hook
Hook reads leads, settings, products from useCRM() context
Stores queue in localStorage under key 'autopilot-queue' as JSON string of AutopilotQueue shape
On mount: loads queue from localStorage if it exists, has pending actions (status === 'pending'), and generatedAt is less than 24 hours old
generateQueue() method: calls preFilterLeads then generateActionQueue, wraps result in AutopilotQueue with generatedAt = new Date().toISOString(), saves to localStorage
completeAction(actionId, summary) method: marks action status as 'completed', calls addNoteToLead(action.leadId, 'Autopilot: ' + summary), updates localStorage
snoozeAction(actionId) method: removes action from current position and appends to end of actions array with status still 'pending', updates localStorage
refreshQueue() method: forces regeneration regardless of pending actions
setActionContent(actionId, content) method: sets the content field on the matching action

Exposes: queue (AutopilotQueue | null), pendingActions (AutopilotAction[]), pendingCount (number), isGenerating (boolean), currentAction (first pending action or null), generateQueue, completeAction, snoozeAction, refreshQueue, setActionContent
Listens to window 'storage' event to sync queue state across tabs
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This hook imports from services/geminiService, services/crmService, utils/autopilotHelpers, and contexts/CRMContext

userStories.title: Autopilot page — queue display
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my action queue as a clear, ordered list so I can work through it top to bottom.
acceptanceCriteria: Create components/AutopilotPage.tsx as the main component for the Daily Sales Plan page
Create pages/Autopilot.tsx as a thin wrapper that renders AutopilotPage
Add Route path='/autopilot' element={<AutopilotPageRoute />} in App.tsx inside the Routes block, importing the page
Page uses useAutopilotQueue() hook for all queue state
Shows queue as a vertical list of action cards ordered by priority

Each card shows: lead company name, action type icon (Phone for call, Mail for email, Share2 for social, FileText for note — all from lucide-react), priority indicator (colored dot), reasoning (1 line), and a 'Start' button
Queue summary at top: 'X actions remaining' with a progress bar showing completed/total ratio
Empty state when queue is empty: 'All caught up! 🎉' message with a 'Generate New Queue' button
Loading state with skeleton/pulse placeholder cards while isGenerating is true
Refresh Queue button in header that calls refreshQueue(), disabled while isGenerating
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: Follow existing component patterns: named export, React.FC, Tailwind dark theme with slate palette

userStories.title: Action execution view
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the pre-generated content for an action and execute it in one click so I can move fast.
acceptanceCriteria: When user clicks Start on a queue card in AutopilotPage, the view expands inline to show the full action detail panel

On expand, if action.content is empty/undefined, call generateActionContent with the lead data (look up lead from leads array by action.leadId) and show a Loader2 spinner until content arrives, then call setActionContent to cache it
Show: lead name, contact info (phone as tel: link, email as mailto: link), action type label, AI reasoning, and the full generated content rendered as text
Copy to Clipboard button that calls navigator.clipboard.writeText() with the content and shows a toast via addToast
Mark Complete button: calls completeAction(actionId, summary) where summary is a short description like 'Sent follow-up email to [companyName]', then auto-advances to next pending action
Snooze button: calls snoozeAction(actionId), advances to next pending action
Regenerate button: re-calls generateActionContent for this action, replaces content, shows loading during regeneration
After completing/snoozing, automatically shows the next pending action (currentAction from hook)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: The execution view is part of AutopilotPage.tsx, not a separate route. Look up the full lead object from CRMContext leads array using action.leadId.

userStories.title: Navigation badge for Daily Sales Plan
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a badge on the Daily Sales Plan nav item showing how many actions are pending so I know at a glance if I have work to do.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Daily Sales Plan nav button in components/Layout.tsx using the Zap icon from lucide-react, positioned between Lead Finder AI and Settings in both desktop sidebar and mobile bottom nav
Nav button navigates to /autopilot on click
Use useAutopilotQueue() hook in Layout to get pendingCount
Show a numeric badge (small circle, bg-brand-500 background, white text, text-[10px] font-bold) when pendingCount > 0, positioned as a superscript on the nav item
Badge is hidden when pendingCount is 0
Update getActiveTab() to return 'autopilot' when location.pathname starts with '/autopilot'
Apply active styling (bg-slate-800 text-brand-400 border border-slate-700) when activeTab is 'autopilot'
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: The Layout component will need to import useAutopilotQueue from hooks/useAutopilotQueue

userStories.title: Auto-generate queue on app load
userStories.description: As a user, I want the queue to generate automatically when I open the app so actions are ready when I navigate to the Daily Sales Plan page.
acceptanceCriteria: In useAutopilotQueue hook: add a useEffect that runs on mount (after leads and settings are loaded) — if no valid queue exists (null, empty pending actions, or generatedAt older than 24 hours), call generateQueue() automatically
If a valid queue with pending actions exists and is less than 24 hours old, do nothing (keep existing queue from localStorage)
Generation runs silently with no UI side effects outside the Autopilot page — isGenerating flag is set but no toasts or spinners appear elsewhere
The pending count exposed by the hook updates when generation completes, which triggers the badge in Layout to appear
Guard against generating when leads array is empty (wait for CRM data to load first)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This behavior is inside the existing useAutopilotQueue hook from US-006. The useEffect should depend on leads.length and settings to avoid firing before data loads.

userStories.title: Queue invalidation for deleted/changed leads
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the queue to gracefully handle leads that were deleted or moved to excluded statuses after the queue was generated.
acceptanceCriteria: In useAutopilotQueue hook or in AutopilotPage rendering: when computing pendingActions, check if each action's leadId exists in the current leads array from CRMContext
If a lead was deleted (not found in leads array), automatically mark the action status as 'skipped' and do not display it
If a lead's status changed to one not in settings.autopilotStatuses, show the action card grayed out (opacity-50) with a small note 'Lead status changed' and only show a Snooze button (no Start)
Update pendingCount to exclude invalidated actions
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This can be a computed/memoized value derived from queue.actions + leads + settings in the hook
